summary: Iteration 122 - Liquid Live Editor Enhancement Testing: All features working correctly. Backend API tests 100% passed (13/13). Frontend UI tests verified all new components including undo/redo, clear draft, canvas overlay, copy/paste for custom cards, page navigation, and bot local commands.
seed_data_creation: Test customizations created and cleaned up during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Liquid Live Editor features from iteration 122 are working: Undo/Redo buttons (disabled when stack empty), Clear Draft button, Save and Publish button, Canvas toggle, Copy/Paste for custom cards (0→1→2 count verified), Page selector navigation, Bot local commands, and /customers page now correctly shows 5 blocks (not 0).

undo_redo_buttons.notes: Both buttons present, correctly disabled when undo/redo stacks are empty

clear_draft_button.notes: Button present and functional, clears local draft and reloads from backend

save_publish_button.notes: Button shows 'حفظ ونشر التغييرات' (Save and Publish Changes)

canvas_toggle.notes: Canvas button present in sidebar, toggles canvas overlay

custom_card_copy_paste.notes: Copy/paste workflow verified: 0→1→2 cards count works correctly

customers_page_canvas_capture.notes: /customers page shows 5 كرت/بلوك (5 blocks), NOT 0 - canvas capture fix verified

bot_tab_local_commands.notes: Bot tab shows quick actions (rrr, EXIT, etc.), local command 'اعرض لي كروت هذه الصفحة' switches to cards tab

live_cards_section.notes: Live cards section shows correct count (17 on dashboard, 5 on /customers)

custom_cards_section.notes: Custom cards section with add/paste buttons working

backend_positions_api.notes: Positions field in customization API saves and retrieves correctly (for Alt+Drag)

backend_contents_api.notes: Contents field in customization API saves and retrieves correctly (for inline editing)

backend_block_order_api.notes: Block order field in customization API saves and retrieves correctly (for drag reordering)

regression_check.live_cards_refresh: PASS - Refresh correctly on page switch
regression_check.custom_cards_crud: PASS - Add, copy, paste, delete working

local_storage_draft_workflow.notes: Draft is saved to localStorage before publish. Clear draft button removes local draft and reloads from backend. Save button publishes to backend and clears local draft.
